title: Quick Options › Sound (Shell)
about: The Shell's Sound page against the Design Center reference, in pixel mode: the caller supplies <variant>/<state>.png, the page's sheet cut from a session with the reference's outputs and three playing apps (run.sh sound-page --pixel DIR). Phone: the top of the drawer, as tall as the reference. Design review 4 (21 Nov): the page passes at a mean ΔE of 4.0 with no heat on any filled area (surface, wells, chips, master pill, slider tracks, fills, knobs); text heat is Chromium against St, so the over-ΔE10 share is not a limit. Artwork and app badges are left out: they measure image scaling.
